public_task.title: David Mitchell: 4Star Method 1 steps 8–15
public_task.instruction: Complete ONLY Method 1 printed steps 8 through 15. The supplied 2:1 rectangle already has the earlier diagonal precreases and holds the downward half-fold in step 8; start by opening it. Include the printed turnover and all fold-and-unfold operations. Stop unfolded after step 15. Blue corresponds to the coloured side. Do not continue step 16 or later.
